quote: Upon the immediate approach of an authorized emergency vehicle or an official vehicle of a regulatory agency, making use of flashing lights meeting the requirements of subsection 3 of NRS 484A.480 [DEF-NRS-484A-480-3], the driver of every other vehicle shall, except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer: Except as otherwise provided in this paragraph, immediately drive to a position parallel to, and as close as possible to, the right-hand edge or, if applicable, curb of a highway and clear of any intersection. The driver shall not drive to and stop in a position on a paved shoulder of a highway where lawfully placed signage allows a vehicle described in paragraphs (a) to (f), inclusive, of subsection 4 of NRS 484B.210 [list appended below] to drive on the shoulder. The provisions of subparagraph (1) of paragraph (c) of subsection 1 do not apply to: (a) An authorized emergency vehicle described in NRS 484A.480; (b) A vehicle which has been issued a permit to operate as an authorized emergency vehicle pursuant to NRS 484A.490; (c) A traffic incident management vehicle; (d) A tow car; (e) A coroner vehicle; or (f) A public transit motor bus, that is being driven on the paved shoulder of a highway where lawfully placed signage allows that vehicle to use the shoulder in that manner.

activation.condition: Immediate approach of an authorized emergency or regulatory official vehicle using qualifying flashing lights.

obligation.description: Drive immediately to a parallel position as close as possible to the right edge or applicable curb and clear of any intersection; do not drive to and stop on a signed paved shoulder permitting a listed class.

exceptions.source_clause: except when otherwise directed by a law enforcement officer
exceptions.description: Source-bound law-enforcement direction can alter the driver's response.

timing.description: Observe the immediate approach and response over the original 45 seconds.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Observe original relative routes, positions and motion without a numeric legal cutoff.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: parallel to, and as close as possible
judgment_calls_needed.note: Measure actual body yaw and body-to-right-edge distance, retaining feasibility and legal judgment for review.
Measure original body polygon overlap with the reviewed intersection boundary.
Measure actual stop/traverse state and the reviewed lawful sign's listed class and segment applicability.

parameter_refs.name: light_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: qualified active, qualified inactive or unqualified active

parameter_refs.name: sign_permitted_class
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: none or one of the six listed shoulder-permitted classes
